newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-GOALKEEPER KLOS ENSURES DORTMUND VICTORY OVER ATLETICO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GOALKEEPER KLOS ENSURES DORTMUND VICTORY OVER ATLETICO.

text.p: Borussia Dortmund virtually assured their place in the quarter-finals of the European Cup when they beat Atletico Madrid 1-0 for their third successive Champions' League victory on Wednesday.
World Cup defender Stefan Reuter scored in the 50th minute and that proved sufficient to beat Atletico, who had won their two previous games in Group B.
The Germans had goalkeeper Stefan Klos and a healthy dose of luck to thank for the result in an exciting game in which the Spaniards squandered nearly a dozen clear chances.

After Reuter's goal the Germans retreated into defence. Klos, who had saved superbly from Juan Eduardo Esnaider on the stroke of halftime, went on to deny the Argentine striker on five further occasions.
